title: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Annually 1.9 million deaths and 89.7 million disability-adjusted life years are caused by exposure to agents during work (e.g., welding fumes, silica dust, and noise pollution). To improve worker health, high-quality exposure assessments are crucial. Therefore, free-text job descriptions from large-scale occupational cohorts are manually standardized through occupational classifications and linked to hazardous exposures using Job Exposure Matrices (JEM). However, manual coding is slow, unreliable (i.e., 44-89% inter-coder reliability), and costly, due to i) short, ambiguous free-text job descriptions, ii) classifications containing hundreds to thousands of categories, and iii) the absence of gold standards. With 46%-79% accuracy, state-of-the-art automatic occupational coding tools achieve classification performance on human level. translated_title: 基于检索增强生成的自动职业编码
translated_abstract: 每年有190万人死亡和8970万伤残调整生命年（DALYs）是由工作中有害物质的暴露（如焊接烟尘、硅尘和噪声污染）引起的。为了改善工人健康，高质量的暴露评估至关重要。因此，来自大规模职业队列的自由文本工作描述需要通过职业分类进行人工标准化，并使用工作暴露矩阵（JEM）与有害暴露建立关联。然而，人工编码速度慢、可靠性低（即编码员间信度仅为44-89%）且成本高昂，原因在于：i) 自由文本工作描述简短且模糊；ii) 分类系统包含数百到数千个类别；iii) 缺乏黄金标准。目前最先进的自动职业编码工具以46%-79%的准确率达到了与人类相当的表现水平。然而，它们在分布外数据集上的性能下降至17-26%。此外，其监督式...
tldr: 该论文提出利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术实现自动职业编码，以解决人工编码速度慢、可靠性低、成本高以及现有自动编码工具在分布外数据集上性能大幅下降的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes automatic occupational coding using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to address the slow, unreliable, and costly nature of manual coding, as well as the significant performance degradation of existing automatic tools on out-of-distribution datasets.
